issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in add() - duplicate IDs possible with concurrent processes

plan.summary: Fix race condition in TodoApp.add() where concurrent processes can generate duplicate IDs
plan.root_cause: The add() method loads todos, computes next_id based on loaded state, then saves. Between load and save, another process could complete the same sequence with the same next_id, causing duplicate IDs.
plan.solution_approach: Implement file locking using fcntl.flock to ensure atomicity of add() operations across concurrent processes

tdd_sequence.description: Create failing regression test that spawns multiple processes calling add() concurrently and verifies all IDs are unique
Implement file locking in TodoStorage.exclusive_lock() and use it in TodoApp.add()
Run all tests to ensure fix works and no regressions

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py tests/test_issue_5113_concurrent_add_duplicate_id.py

implementation.summary: Fixed race condition by adding file locking using fcntl.flock. The exclusive_lock() context manager in TodoStorage acquires an exclusive lock before load/save operations in add().

changes.description: Added exclusive_lock() context manager using fcntl.flock for advisory file locking
Modified add() to use exclusive_lock() for atomic load-compute-save operation
Added regression tests for concurrent add() race condition

risks: File locking uses fcntl.flock which is Unix-specific; not available on Windows
Advisory locking only works if all processes cooperate; external processes modifying the file won't be blocked
limitations: Only add() operation uses locking; other operations (mark_done, mark_undone, remove) may still have race conditions but are less critical for ID uniqueness
